text:
elaine: FYI — Kairos renewal review. Their current committed ARR is $250,000/yr, contract up in 45 days. They're pushing for a 25% uplift to cover new usage; AE asked for guidance on pricing path and POC follow-up.

tom_s: Can you drop the usage breakdown? are they expanding embeddings or generation?

elaine: Mostly generation (chat) for customer support + a small uptick in embeddings for search. Usage trend: +40% qtr-over-qtr last 2 quarters.

jordan: tagging RevOps — we need to check their current rate card band and any legacy discounts. @marta can you run a reprice with commit tiers?

marta: Will do. Quick heads up: if we ask for a 12–18 month commit increase we can offer a blended discount. Can you confirm target ARR?

elaine: The proposed ARR after uplift would be $310k if they accept 24% uplift. They want flexible ramp though — not full upfront commit.

priya: Legal note — if we're adding new data connectors (their security team requested an SFTP integration in the SOW), need to include the SSLA clause for data handling. Also they'll sign a revised DPA.

kian: CS chiming in — Kairos requested a 4-week POC for the new multi-tenant prompt templates. They expect hands-on support and a success playbook. We should include a statement of work for the POC scope.

elaine: Can deal desk support a staged commit? They want to start with a 6-month pilot commit at 60% of proposed ARR, then ramp to full by month 12.

marta: We can structure a two-step commit: Pilot commit = $186k (60% of $310k) + conversion to full $310k at end of 6 months. Pricing wise I can offer 8% discount during pilot and 14% afterward as long as conversion is guaranteed.

tom_s: From a technical presales view we need to confirm latency SLOs for their support workflow — they're very sensitive to <200ms 95th for short prompts. Which model family are they on?

elaine: Currently on rdx-large quantised. They asked about upgrade to rdx-xl for faster RPS but that adds cost.

tom_s: Suggest a canary: route 20% of sessions to rdx-xl for 4 weeks, measure latency and cost delta. If 95p <200ms we keep it. Need enablement from infra to reserve burst pool.

deploy-bot: Scheduling: Can reserve burst pool "kairos-canary" for 2026-11-03 08:00 UTC — confirm with :ops:.

jordan: Pricing check: if we do pilot 8% then full 14% with conversion, what's ARR net? calc: `pilot = 186000 * 0.92 = 171,120`; `full = 310000 * 0.86 = 266,600` — combined first year approx $437,720 if conversion occurs. Need finance to greenlight.

marta: That's the blended math I had. Also propose a one-time migration credit of $12k to offset the POC support if we get a signed 12-month commitment.

priya: I need to see the new SOW language for the POC, especially intellectual property and data retention paragraphs. Please attach before we send to customer.

elaine: I'll draft SOW and attach. Meanwhile, can deal desk pre-approve the two-step structure so I can present it in tomorrow's call?

marta: I can pre-approve pending RevOps sanity check and Legal sign-off on SOW/DPA. Approve in principle: two-step commit + migration credit + conversion clause.

jordan: RevOps will confirm rate-card alignment by EOD. One ask: mark this as "accelerated renewal" in the system so pricing signals trigger.

kian: CS will own the POC playbook and outcome metrics (latency, ticket deflection, search precision).

tom_s: I'll prepare the canary run checklist and required infra quotas. Quick snippet for infra: ```reserve --pool kairos-canary --gpus 4 --duration 4w --model rdx-xl```

elaine: Thanks all. I'll update thread after I attach SOW. If anyone objects to the pre-approval, flag now. :thumbsup:
